Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar 13.3.1Word Class: Prepositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar 13.3.1Word Class: Prepositions, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: Why should we tell others exactly where people and things are?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar 13.3.1Word Class: Prepositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

s) By the end of the sub strand, the

learner should be able to:


a) recognize signs of words and

phrases related to the theme,

money,


b) identify prepositions of

position and direction in

sentences for comprehension,


c) use prepositions correctly in

oral and written contexts for

effective communication,


d) appreciate the importance of

prepositions for clarity in

communication.


  -  In pairs, learners are guided to watch a

captioned video clip or observe a signed

demonstration of vocabulary related to Money.


  -  In pairs, learners are guided to identify,

fingerspell and sign vocabulary related to

Money.


  -  In pairs, learners are guided to sign read words

indicating prepositions of position and direction

such as: in, into, on. To, from, towards, up,

down, among, between, though, over, under,


  -  In pairs, learners are guided to identify

prepositions in samples of oral, signed or written

texts sentences.


  -  In groups, learners are guided to play grade

appropriate preposition games online or offline.


  -  In pairs, learners are guided to construct

sentences using prepositions.


  -  In pairs, learners are guided to complete gaps in

sentences, matching prepositions with pictures.


  -  In pairs, learners are guided to complete

substitution exercises on various prepositions.


  -  In pairs, learners are guided to watch videos,

visit web pages and other online resources and

pick out prepositions.


  -  In groups, learners are guided to use

prepositions in a role play or simulation of

people paying tax.


  -  In groups, learners are guided to create and

display preposition charts.
